Minbox text archive

Terms of use

Last updated October 14, 2026. These terms describe owner-managed installations and the fixture-tested Mac/iPhone path. Live Mac/iPhone operation remains unverified.

Authorized use

Use Minbox only with accounts and devices you are authorized to access. Each owner completes their own device permissions and any Google consent.

Do not collect another person's account without their authorization.

What the service provides

Minbox provides code and guidance for your agent to collect messages, create filtered output, and connect a suitable AI phone app.

The included implementation can maintain a private Drive archive. Other routes can require adaptation and separate tests.

Availability depends on device synchronization, permissions, account access, network access, and the providers involved.

Minbox is not a complete phone backup. Available original images can be stored privately with source links and optional local OCR.

Unsupported attachments, unavailable history, and inaccessible transcripts can be missing. Keep independent backups if you need recovery protection.

AI answers

Routine collection and full publication do not require a model. Your setup agent needs its own usable model access.

You manage AI sign-in and consent. Your agent can help configure and test the connection.

Collection can run without an AI connection. The full phone-answer goal needs a verified answer and updated-source retrieval from your phone.

Optional work analysis sends selected eligible content to the configured provider. Local-model filtering needs a separate integration.

AI services can misread messages or omit context. Check original sources before making decisions.

A citation or status message does not guarantee accuracy or complete history.

Account access and updates

You can stop background jobs and revoke Google access. Revocation does not erase stored archives.

Manage local and provider copies separately. Application updates need review and installation. They can require new permissions or dependencies.

Health notifications

Optional external email covers unresolved emergencies that require human action. Routine failures, reminders, and recovery do not send mail.

A local monitor cannot report a complete host or network outage.

Other services

Google, Apple, Loom, GitHub, hosting providers, and AI services have their own terms and privacy policies.

Minbox does not guarantee their availability or control their operation.

Questions

Contact spencer.r.h@gmail.com. Read the privacy policy before authorizing an installation.
